ideas.title: Remix Streams `defer()` Data but the Page Stalls Because No `<Await>` Boundary Wraps It
ideas.description: Make Remix deferred data render correctly by wiring the loader, suspense boundary, and fallback together.
ideas.angle: Explain how `defer()` returns a promise that must be consumed by `<Await>` inside a `Suspense` boundary, and why the HTML can render while the deferred part never resolves visibly. Cover the loader shape, the component structure, and the exact boundary placement required for streamed data.

ideas.title: Node Imports a Local ESM File as `[ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]` Because the Path Is Not a File URL
ideas.description: Fix local ESM imports in Node when relative paths or missing extensions stop module resolution.
ideas.angle: Cover the resolution rules for native ESM in Node, including why `import './module'` can fail when the file extension is omitted. Explain the difference between package resolution and file URL resolution, and show the correct `./module.js` or `fileURLToPath` pattern for local modules.

ideas.title: Docker Compose Starts an API Before Postgres Is Ready and the App Logs `ECONNREFUSED`
ideas.description: Use health checks and dependency conditions so Compose waits for Postgres instead of starting the app too early.
ideas.angle: Explain why `depends_on` only controls container start order and not service readiness, which leaves the app connecting before Postgres accepts connections. Show a healthcheck for Postgres, the correct `depends_on: condition: service_healthy` setup, and the fallback retry behavior the app should still keep.

ideas.title: Nginx Proxies a WebSocket Endpoint but the Client Fails the Upgrade with `400 Bad Request`
ideas.description: Fix WebSocket proxying by forwarding the upgrade headers and using the right HTTP version.
ideas.angle: Describe how Nginx strips upgrade semantics unless `proxy_http_version 1.1` and the `Upgrade` and `Connection` headers are forwarded correctly. Explain why the backend sees a normal HTTP request instead of a WebSocket handshake, and include the exact location block needed to preserve the upgrade.

drafted.title: Express Mounts a Router at the Wrong Path and Every Nested Route Returns `Cannot GET /api/...`
drafted.description: Fix router mounting mistakes that make Express serve 404s for routes that exist in the child router.
drafted.angle: Describe how `app.use('/api', router)` changes every route inside the router and why leading slashes inside the child router can produce surprising paths. Show how `req.baseUrl`, `req.path`, and `router.use()` interact, and give a concrete file layout and mount path that match.
